settings.general.webdavHint: Two-way merge of playlists / download templates / history across devices (machine-specific settings excluded). Sync merges only — deletions are NOT propagated: a song or playlist deleted on one device comes back if another device still holds it in an older snapshot (delete it on every device to get rid of it). The password is encrypted locally and never exported
